items.quote: Consider first the rotated three-month winter pantry.
items.problem: Post-apply lint catch (Part A, Imperative openers): 'Consider first...' triggered the imperative-opener rule. Refreshed with two non-abrupt declarative openers.

alternates.label: explicit 'The first example'
alternates.text: The first example is the rotated three-month winter pantry.

alternates.label: lead directly with the pantry
alternates.text: A rotated three-month winter pantry shows how a sound reserve works.

answers.text: Good catch — 'The first is...' was too abrupt across the paragraph break. Added two clearer non-imperative openers: 'a' names 'The first example', and 'b' opens directly on the pantry itself.
